en: Black-and-white postcard image showing a large late‑19th‑century brick villa with ornate window decorations and a steep tiled roof, partly obscured by tall leafy trees. In the foreground there is a riverside promenade with railings, a striped pavilion or kiosk, and pedestrians walking along the path. At the top, printed in red, is the caption indicating the place and building name.
